original.target_description: Regression relationship between simplicity and inventory management in the Dutch sample. Located R2 is for the combined regression on simplicity and discipline factors, rather than a separate regression for the named predictor group.

n.exclusions: Food and Tobacco, Chemical and Textile sectors and sectors with fewer than 30 sites were omitted (p. 137). Test-specific missing-data exclusions are not reported.

notes: Published article copy, Collins, Cordon and Julien (1998). R2 cell visually verified on rendered primary page. No separate simplicity-only or discipline-only R2 is printed. Table R2 is the full outcome regression across both predictor groups; target_match is false for a group-specific interpretation. No model-level P-value is printed: coefficient P-values belong to individual predictors and cannot be paired with the overall R2. Discussion states 48 Dutch companies but no test-specific analytic N. Replication and success are unassigned.
